newsitem.title: USA: American Western sale of Illinois refinery cleared.
newsitem.headline: American Western sale of Illinois refinery cleared.

text.p: American Western Refining LP, current owner of an 86,000 barrel per day refinery in Lawrenceville, Ill., and a petroleum storage terminal in Mt. Vernon, Ind., said Tueday the bankruptcy court has approved the sale of these assets.
All qualified bids must be submitted for review by the debtor no later than December 17, the partnership said, adding the auction will be held on December 20 in Wilmington, Del.
On November 6, American Western said, it filed for reorganization under Chapter 11 of the Bankruptcy Code.
Since then, it said, the court approved the financing needed to maintain the partnership's assets through December 31. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
